claims.claim: For plan year 2027, the individual-market open enrollment period on the federal platform runs November 1 through December 15.
Medicare Open Enrollment runs October 15 through December 7 each year.

For contract year 2027, CMS removed the prior 48-hour Scope of Appointment waiting period while retaining pre-appointment documentation requirements; applicable TPMO marketing, sales, and enrollment calls must be recorded.
Marketplace applicants should update income and household changes because those changes can affect coverage and premium tax credit amounts.
People who lose Medicaid or CHIP may be able to enroll in Marketplace coverage through a Special Enrollment Period, subject to current eligibility and timing rules.
Plan-specific Medicare provider, pharmacy, and drug review should use current Medicare Plan Compare and current plan documents for the exact plan year.
The 2026 premium tax credit applicable percentage table ranges from 2.10 percent below 133 percent FPL to 9.96 percent from 300 through 400 percent FPL.
